map.ISO 354 用混响室法测定建筑制品吸声系数，其计算基础就是赛宾公式与吸声量换: ISO 354 measures the sound absorption coefficient of building products by the reverberation room method, and its calculation is based on the Sabine formula and the absorption-area conversion, making it the source standard for the coefficients in reports.

map.实验室实测常出现 α>1，源于安装方式、边缘效应与测试不确定度；工程取值一般按标: Laboratory measurements often give α>1, arising from the mounting method, edge effects and test uncertainty; engineering values are generally taken as the single value given for standard conditions rather than at extremes.

map.：混响室体积 V=200 m³，空室混响时间 T0=6.0 s，铺装 S=10: : with a reverberation chamber volume V=200 m³, an empty-room reverberation time T0=6.0 s and T1=4.5 s after laying a S=10 m² sample, A=0.161V/T gives an empty-room absorption A0=53.7 sabins and A1=71.6 sabins after laying, so the sample contributes ΔA=17.9 and the absorption coefficient α=ΔA/S=1.79 (>1 is the normal upper limit, due to edge and mounting conditions).
